cohort: 1000 pregnant women screened with serum TSH at their first antenatal visit, divided into control (852), new hypothyroid (110), and known hypothyroid (38) groups.
finding: Hypothyroid pregnant women had a significantly higher frequency of pre-eclampsia, GDM, anemia, IUGR, oligohydramnios, induction of labor, caesarean section, PPH, small for gestational age babies, and neonatal admissions.
birth_weight: High frequency of birth weights between 2.6-3 kg across all groups.
